updateserver.name: PHP-Adminer
updateserver.desc: Manage your MySQL databases in the browser with Adminer: tables, data, SQL queries, import and export. Log in with one of your own MySQL users.
updateserver.updatedesc: Opening PHP-Adminer again takes you straight back to your open Adminer login instead of its login page; the list of open logins (two or more) wraps neatly in the menu instead of running over the form. Includes the security fix from 633.
